about: Every code: HTTP status (an HTTP error body is {code, error}; a socket ack carries code only), and when.

session.when: no / expired / unknown play session (HTTP) or a frame before auth (socket: bye session)

guest.when: a guest account, the Memories recorder or the system account tried to sign in

not-member.when: not joined to the room (as this server sees it), or the room isn't this server's

not-in-call.when: needs a live call membership in the room (open a table, sit, join, watch)

remote-refused.when: the user's server is not on this server's federation list

rig-hidden.when: The Rig from an ios-app/android-app session while the owner's switch is off

no-space.when: the room has no game space (in no space, or a space itself): games live in spaces

wrong-server.when: the room's game space is kept by another server (the body names space + server: show it, never follow it)

space-changed.when: the space you sent (create / wallet / sit / join) isn't the room's game space any more: refresh what you show

unavailable.when: this server can't see the room's space in full (state unknown or still filling in): try again later

no-table.when: no such table (or not visible to you; a table id alone grants nothing)

no-wallet.when: you haven't opted in on this server (POST /wallet first)

seated-elsewhere.when: one table at a time per person per server

one-per-room.when: an open table of that game already exists in this room

seated.when: delete refused while you're at a table

open-money.when: delete / prestige wait: something of yours is still in play

rate.when: too many requests or frames (socket: over the limit again = closed)

off.when: games are turned off on this server (the dashboard switch), or draining

stale.when: the move named another turn (hand+turn / round+spin+phase): refresh from the newest view

not-your-turn.when: not your turn (or not your role)

bad-action.when: a move that isn't allowed now (check facing a bet, Walk before walk_from, …)

bad-amount.when: raise below the minimum / above your stack; dial outside 1..3 or above the bankroll; stake outside its range

no-chips.when: not enough chips (sit with 0 and no top-up, Call needs bankroll >= 2, Peek needs 2, …)

limit.when: a per-round count used up (Calls, Audit, Mutes, Nudge, Whisper, Peek)

locked.when: Peek after the lock (after spin peek_lock_after)

taken.when: someone else's Nudge already won this spin

rules.when: a Patch / keep that would break the machine rules (bites > 6, two Taxes, a card twice)

greyed.when: that card is dead, busted or wrongly called (can't be Called or Patched in)

host-only.when: only the table's host can do that

cooldown.when: a reaction too soon (your bucket, or the table's minute is full): the ack carries retry_ms; the socket stays open

op-reused.when: an admin write's op was already used for a different request

bad-reason.when: an admin why-text that is empty, too long, has control characters or a link, or looks like a Matrix id

bad-value.when: an economy value outside its bounds (the answer names the key, min and max)

at-table.when: the person has open money (at a table, in a round): only a grant is allowed

not-admin.when: you aren't an admin of that space (power level 100 in the space) nor the server owner

not-broke.when: Tune In is only for people at or below the broke line (4 chips)

day-max.when: today's Tune In chips are used up

side-off.when: Tune In is switched off for this space (or this server)

no-run.when: no such Tune In run for you (expired, finished, or the server restarted)
